title: Code and data for: Finite-Shot Operating Windows for Virtual Distillation and Symmetry Verification
description: Code and data for the paper "Finite-Shot Operating Windows for Virtual Distillation and Symmetry Verification" (arXiv:2606.15464). Level 1: exact density-matrix simulation of QAOA instances that tests the finite-shot laws for virtual distillation (VD) and symmetry verification (SV). Level 2: gate-level Qiskit/Aer simulation of the same instances. Level 3: archived IBM hardware counts and their analysis. Code is MIT-licensed; data and figures are CC-BY-4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA).
